{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a soft pointed collar, hip length, ivory (#F3EDE0), matte crepe

This outfit sits right in the neat business-casual band: a blouse with tailored trousers and a textured blazer, finished with loafers. The ivory blouse and charcoal trousers form a calm base, while the herringbone blazer adds warmth and depth that suit autumn. The burgundy loafers and belt tie in with the cognac bag for a coordinated, grown-up palette.
